knowledge_base.question: How should I charge my Elyra day to day?
knowledge_base.answer: For daily driving keep the battery between 20% and 80% and use AC charging at home or work. Charge to 100% before long trips. DC fast charging is safe whenever you need it; the car manages battery temperature automatically. Set a charge limit in the Elyra app under Energy > Charging.

knowledge_base.question: How do I precondition the battery for fast charging?
knowledge_base.answer: Set a DC fast charger as your navigation destination and the car warms or cools the battery on the way. You can also start preconditioning manually under Energy > Battery Preconditioning. It can noticeably cut charging time in cold weather.

knowledge_base.question: Can Elyra install a home charger?
knowledge_base.answer: Yes. Elyra Charge supplies and installs 11 kW and 22 kW wall boxes through certified local partners. Order it with your car or later from the Elyra app under Energy > Home Charging. A site survey is included.

knowledge_base.question: Why is my range lower in winter?
knowledge_base.answer: Cold temperatures reduce battery efficiency and cabin heating uses energy. Precondition the cabin while plugged in, use seat and steering-wheel heating, and keep tyres at the recommended pressure. A 15-30% drop in winter range is normal.

knowledge_base.question: How do over-the-air (OTA) updates work?
knowledge_base.answer: When an update is available you get a notification in the car and the Elyra app. Install it while parked with at least 30% charge; the car can't be driven during installation (about 30-40 minutes). You can schedule it overnight under Settings > Software.

knowledge_base.question: What does the warranty cover?
knowledge_base.answer: The vehicle warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship. The high-voltage battery warranty covers defects and capacity loss below the minimum guaranteed health. Wear items, accident damage and misuse aren't covered. Terms vary by market.

knowledge_base.question: What does roadside assistance include?
knowledge_base.answer: 24/7 help for breakdowns, flat tyres, flat 12V batteries, lockouts and running out of charge, including towing to the nearest Elyra service centre or charger. It's included for the roadside assistance period of the warranty. Call the roadside number for your country or use SOS in the Elyra app.

knowledge_base.question: What tyre pressure should I use?
knowledge_base.answer: The recommended cold tyre pressures are on the label in the driver's door frame and on the centre display under Vehicle > Tyres. For most Elyra models it is 2.7-3.0 bar. Check pressures monthly and before long trips.

knowledge_base.question: How do I share my digital key?
knowledge_base.answer: In the Elyra app go to Vehicle > Digital Key > Share, then choose the person, access level and time period. They need the Elyra app and an account. You can revoke access at any time.

knowledge_base.question: How often does an Elyra need servicing?
knowledge_base.answer: Every 24 months or 30,000 km, whichever comes first. Cabin air filters may need replacing more often in dusty or polluted areas, and tyre rotation is recommended every 10,000 km. Elyra Care prepaid plans cover scheduled services for 3 or 5 years.

knowledge_base.question: What should I do if the car warns that the 12V battery is low?
knowledge_base.answer: The 12V battery powers door locks, displays and control systems. Drive the car or keep it plugged in so the high-voltage battery can top it up. If the warning comes back, book a 12V battery check; replacement takes about 30 minutes.

knowledge_base.question: How do I book a test drive?
knowledge_base.answer: Book a test drive on the Elyra website or in the Elyra app under Discover > Test Drive. Choose a model, a location (showroom or at your home in selected cities) and a time. Test drives last about 45 minutes.

knowledge_base.question: How do I order an Elyra and how long is delivery?
knowledge_base.answer: Configure and order online or at an Elyra space. A refundable deposit reserves your car. Typical delivery is 6-10 weeks depending on model and market; your order page in the app shows the latest estimate.

knowledge_base.question: What connected services are included?
knowledge_base.answer: Remote climate, charging control, location, digital key, OTA updates and emergency call are included for the life of the car. Premium connectivity (streaming, in-car Wi-Fi hotspot) is free for the first 3 years, then available as a subscription.

knowledge_base.question: Can an Elyra tow a trailer?
knowledge_base.answer: Yes, when fitted with the factory tow bar. Towing capacity depends on the model, from 1,000 kg (Elyra 007) to 2,000 kg (Elyra 7X and 009). Range drops noticeably when towing; plan charging stops accordingly.

knowledge_base.question: What data does my car share with Elyra?
knowledge_base.answer: Vehicle health and software data are used to provide services and updates. Location and driving data are only shared with your consent, which you can change at any time in the Elyra app under Settings > Privacy.

knowledge_base.question: How long will the battery last?
knowledge_base.answer: Elyra batteries are designed to last the life of the car. Capacity loss is typically small and gradual, and the battery warranty guarantees at least 70% health for 8 years. Avoid leaving the car at 100% or below 10% for long periods.

knowledge_base.question: Any tips for winter driving?
knowledge_base.answer: Use winter tyres where required, precondition while plugged in, keep the charge above 20%, and use the Snow drive mode. In Sweden, Elyra service centres offer seasonal tyre changes and a tyre hotel.
